--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CRD_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CRD_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CRD_ID ORDER BY [FILE_NAME] DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.ATM_CARD_WITH_DUP_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD_WITH_DUP_20240321;

--5 CREATE BU TABLE
SELECT * INTO BUSC.ATM_CARD_BU_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD;

--6 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.ATM_CARD_WITH_DUP_20240321 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_CARD; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--8 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_CARD --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT 
CRD_ID
,CRD_PAN
,CRD_CARD_SEQUENCE_NBR
,CRD_CPD_ID

,CRD_DISCRETIONARY_DATA_2
,CRD_CARDHOLDER_NAME
,CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR1
,CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR2
,CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR3
,CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR4
,CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR5
,CRD_REGISTRATION_ZIP_CODE
,CRD_COMMENT
,CRD_CREATION_DATE
,CRD_STATUS_1
,CRD_STATUS_1_DATE
,CRD_STATUS_2
,CRD_STATUS_2_DATE
,CRD_PVKI
,CRD_PREV_PIN_CHANGE_DATE
,CRD_CURRENT_PVV
,CRD_PREVIOUS_PVV
,CRD_PIN_RETRY_COUNT
,CRD_PRIMARY_ACN_ID
,CRD_SECONDARY_ACN_ID
,CRD_LAST_FEP_HOST_TRACE_NBR
,CRD_LAST_HOST_FEP_TRACE_NBR
,CRD_PART_NO

,CRD_LIMIT_CONFIG
,CRD_MULTIPLE_ACCOUNTS
,CRD_CUST_ID
,CRD_PIN_MAILER_CADD_ID_FK
,CRD_STMT_MAILER_CADD_ID_FK
,CRD_CARD_DELIVERY_CADD_ID_FK

 FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD_WITH_DUP_20240321; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records

--9 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CRD_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CRD_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--10 COUNT TARGET
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD;

--11 COUNT DUPS
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CARD_WITH_DUP_20240321
